mode: Original Queue WebView login retained; no separate Chrome/CDP, no shop-tab architecture change
observedProblem: The sign-in window frequently stopped on Roblox's 'Verify you're human / Press and hold' card, and after the operator solved it the host did not finish the login.
causes: Every attempt used a brand-new WebView2 profile that was deleted afterwards, so Roblox saw an unknown device on each order; the Chrome-based build that worked earlier reused a known profile.
The 60 second form window closed while the operator was solving the verification, so the password was discarded and no fill or submit could follow.
After the dialog half-filled the form and then waited for the next one second tick, the form sat half-complete, which is also when the verification card appeared.
changes: One shared WebView2 profile (profiles\device) is reused for sign-in so the device is recognised; .ROBLOSECURITY is revoked before the window opens and before it closes, and the profile directory is never deleted while a session could be live.
A human verification no longer destroys the credential window: the form window reopens for 120s after verification resolves and stays bounded.

When the password field is already usable both fields are filled in a single pass (username first), and after filling the username the host polls every 150ms so the password and the click follow immediately instead of on the next tick.
Panel text for the verification codes tells the operator to press and hold in the login window and that the job continues automatically.

nodeTests.newCases: single-pass FILL_BOTH when the password is usable, late verification may still finish the login, reopened form window stays bounded

nativeBuild: passed x64 compile and full native self-tests

browserSmoke.offlineLogin: passed in real Chrome on synthetic markup: dialog with disabled password, dialog with usable password (FILL_BOTH), zero network requests
browserSmoke.panel: message text updated for the hold-button card

livePublicProbe.result: ready=true, stage=READY via FILL_BOTH, submit=CLICKED, detected=CUSTOMER_PASSWORD_INVALID
livePublicProbe.stored: no credentials written to disk; probe profile deleted

installation: Staged 1.3.3 in LOCALAPPDATA and in D:\BewpakornQueue-1.0.0\extension (the path Chrome loads); release checksums, live extension hashes and installed host hash verified.
preservedData: Ledger, history and RAM data untouched; the new shared profile starts empty, so the first sign-in may still show the verification once.
limitations: The verification card cannot be triggered or solved without a real account, so the post-verification resume is covered by policy tests and the browser fixture rather than a live solve.
Roblox decides when to challenge; the shared profile makes it rare but cannot guarantee it never appears.
